name: fresh-reader
description: Spawns a cold-start read-only subagent with zero prior session context to review documentation as a first-time reader, triages 100% of findings with discernment (Accept, Link, or Won't Do), and re-verifies edits until a pass yields zero new changes.
suggestedPrompts: Run a fresh-reader pass on README.md and docs/ as a first-time visitor
Review this documentation with fresh eyes and triage every finding before editing
Check whether this onboarding guide makes sense to someone with zero project context
